experiment_data.hypothesis: Cross-model seed robustness: exception_only with seed=123 on DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B (plan_008). Further validates exception signal cross-model generalization (99.33% seed42).

previous_failure.notes: NEGATIVE: accuracy 91.09% vs seed42 99.83% (-8.74pp). fail_recall=0.705, train_loss=0.122 偏高。DeepSeek exception_only 对 seed 不鲁棒，seed42 的 99.83% 可能是 LoRA 初始化运气。Exception signal 仍有效（+19.6pp over baseline）但跨模型稳定性不成立。
